newsitem.title: USA: Perma-Fix in Silo teaming arrangements.
newsitem.headline: Perma-Fix in Silo teaming arrangements.

text.p: Perma-Fix Environmental Services Inc on Wednesday said it has completed teaming arrangements to pursue the Silo Projects at the U.S. Department of Energy's Fernald Environmental Restoration Project operated by Fluor Daniel/GTI Inc.
The Fernald Silo Projects will provide safe removal, treatment, and off-site disposal of 13,000 cubic meters of radioactive and hazardous waste residues from the processing of fuel.
The cost to treat the Silo 3 Project is estimated at $30 million. The cost to treat waste in the total Fernald Silo Projects is estimated at $120 million.
Perma-Fix provides hazardous, mixed and industrial waste management services, along with environmental engineering and consulting services.
